description: This file defines functions and constants related to generating signatures (hashes) for label sets and metrics in the Prometheus monitoring system. It includes functions for creating fingerprints from labels, with different methods optimized for speed or collision detection.

methods.name: LabelsToSignature
methods.description: Generates a quasi-unique signature (hash) for a given label set represented as a map.

methods.name: labelSetToFingerprint
methods.description: Converts a LabelSet to a Fingerprint, similar to LabelsToSignature but works with LabelSet type.

methods.name: labelSetToFastFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a faster, less collision-resistant fingerprint from a LabelSet.

methods.name: SignatureForLabels
methods.description: Generates a signature for a Metric including only specified LabelNames.

methods.name: SignatureWithoutLabels
methods.description: Generates a signature for a Metric excluding certain LabelNames.
